summary.en: The inaugural FIFA ASEAN Cup Division 2 tournament opened at Hong Kong's Mong Kok Stadium, with Laos beating Brunei 3-1 in the opener. Fourteen teams are taking part, with the Hong Kong leg featuring China Hong Kong, Laos, Brunei, Myanmar, Cambodia and Timor-Leste from 24 September to 3 October. China Hong Kong, who sat out the opening day, face Laos on 27 September and Brunei on 30 September at the Kai Tak Stadium, with the group winners contesting the final on 3 October.

summary.zh_hans: 首届国际足联东盟杯第二级别赛事在香港旺角大球场揭开战幕，老挝在揭幕战以3:1击败文莱，取得小组赛首胜。本届赛事共有14支国家和地区队伍参与，香港赛区的6支队伍包括中国香港、老挝、文莱、缅甸、柬埔寨及东帝汶，赛事由9月24日至10月3日举行。首轮轮空的中国香港队将于9月27日及9月30日在启德体育园主场馆分别迎战老挝和文莱，两组首名将于10月3日争夺冠军。

summary.en: Sun Yingsha beat Hina Hayata 3-1, Wang Manyu edged Miwa Harimoto 3-2 after trailing 4-7 in the decider, and Kuai Man blanked Mima Ito 3-0 as China swept hosts Japan 3-0. summary.en: Japan beat China 3-2 in the Nagoya Asian Games men's table tennis team final on Sept 24, ending China's eight-title streak since 1994 and winning the event for the first time in 60 years. Wang Chuqin beat Matsushima Sora 3-2 and Lin Shidong beat Togami Shunsuke 3-1, but 19-year-old Wen Ruibo lost twice — 1-3 to Harimoto Tomokazu and 1-3 to Matsushima in the decider — while Wang fell 0-3 to Harimoto. It was China's first-ever Asian Games men's team loss to Japan.

summary.zh_hant: 9月24日名古屋亞運乒乓球男團決賽，日本隊以3：2擊敗中國隊，終結中國自1994年起的八連霸，時隔60年重奪亞運男團金牌，亦是國乒在亞運男團史上首次不敵日本。王楚欽首盤3：2逆轉松島輝空、林詩棟3：1勝戶上隼輔為國乒拿下兩分，但19歲小將溫瑞博兩戰皆墨，先後1：3不敵張本智和及松島輝空，王楚欽亦在第四盤0：3負於張本智和。

summary.en: Chiu Hin-chun won Hong Kong's fourth gold of the Asian Games on Thursday, taking the lightweight men's single sculls title in 6:50.32 after trailing Uzbekistan's Firdavs Akhunov at halfway. The 32-year-old, silver medallist in Jakarta 2018 and bronze winner in Hangzhou 2023, said he had 'wanted this very badly' to complete his full set of Asian Games medals. Lam San-tung and Chan Tik-lun added bronze in the lightweight men's double sculls.

summary.en: Rower Chiu Hin-chun won Hong Kong's fourth gold of the Asian Games on Thursday, triumphing in the lightweight men's single sculls in 6 minutes 50.32 seconds. The 32-year-old sat second at halfway before surging clear over the final 1,000 metres to beat Iran's silver medallist by 2.27 seconds. It is Chiu's first Asian Games title at his third attempt, after silver in 2018 and bronze in 2023.

summary.en: Hong Kong's U23 men's football team, surprise semi-finalists three years ago, crashed out of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games after losing all three group matches, finishing 15th and last among the 15 teams. Stand-in head coach Tsang Chiu-tat, who took over after the original coach jumped ship, said the players had given everything but admitted there was a gap to Asian standards. Four senior players return home to join the senior national team for the ASEAN Cup, while Tsang said he was willing to be the 'human shield' for his players amid criticism.
summary.zh_hant: 上屆歷史性殺入四強的香港U23足球代表隊，今屆愛知名古屋亞運三戰皆北，在15支參賽隊伍中敬陪末座，小組出局。臨危受命的主教練曾昭達坦言，球員已盡全力，但承認港隊與亞洲水平有差距；面對外間批評，他表示沒後悔接手球隊，更願意為球員當「擋箭牌」。胡晉銘、顏卓彬、趙聡悟及吳宇曦4位大港腳將歸隊，隨即備戰東盟盃。
summary.zh_hans: 上届历史性杀入四强的香港U23足球代表队，今届爱知名古屋亚运三战皆负，在15支参赛队伍中敬陪末座，小组出局。临危受命的主教练曾昭达坦言，球员已尽全力，但承认港队与亚洲水平有差距；面对外界批评，他表示没后悔接手球队，更愿意为球员当"挡箭牌"。胡晋铭、颜卓彬、赵聪悟及吴宇曦4位大港脚将归队，随即备战东盟杯。

summary.en: China's men, eight-time Asian Games champions since 1974, finished fourth in Nagoya after a record 20-point semifinal loss to Japan (77-97) and a 70-79 bronze-game defeat to Iran, their second-worst finish ever. Selection controversy flared as multiple media figures confirmed Zhou Qi volunteered to play but was left off by coach Guo Shiqiang for missing summer camp, even as the also-injured Yu Jiahao was picked, while Xu Jie reportedly met the same fate. The basketball federation has pledged a full review of selection and the wider system, from scouting to tactics.
summary.zh_hans: 自1974年以来8次夺得亚运金牌的中国男篮，名古屋仅获第四：四强77比97惨败日本刷新亚运最大输球分差，铜牌战又以70比79不敌伊朗，写下队史第二差战绩。选人风波随之爆发：多位媒体人交叉证实，周琦曾主动请缨出战却被主教练郭士强以“缺席夏天集训”为由拒绝，同样养伤的余嘉豪却入选；徐杰亦传主动请战被拒。篮协已表态将对选人用人及整个体系进行全面复盘。
summary.zh_hant: 自1974年以來8次奪得亞運金牌的中國男籃，名古屋僅獲第四：四強77比97慘敗日本刷新亞運最大輸球分差，銅牌戰又以70比79不敵伊朗，寫下隊史第二差戰績。選人風波隨之爆發：多位媒體人交叉證實，周琦曾主動請纓出戰卻被主教練郭士強以「缺席夏天集訓」為由拒絕，同樣養傷的余嘉豪卻入選；徐杰亦傳主動請戰被拒。籃協已表態將對選人用人及整個體系進行全面複盤。

title.en: Eight crowns to fourth place: China's men crumble and the Zhou Qi selection storm erupts

summary.en: China's women beat hosts Japan 3-0 (25-19, 25-20, 25-23) in the Nagoya final on September 22, securing a record tenth Asian Games gold and a third straight title just 22 days after losing the Asian Championship final to Thailand and missing direct Olympic qualification. Star attacker Wu Mengjie torched Japan for 26 points, and the team — averaging under 23 years old with veterans Gong Xiangyu and Wang Mengjie as the only holdovers — roared back from 2-10 down in the third set. The young squad now targets the 2027 World Cup and world rankings for a Los Angeles 2028 ticket.
summary.zh_hans: 中国女排9月22日在名古屋决赛以3比0（25比19、25比20、25比23）横扫东道主日本，夺得队史第十枚亚运金牌、实现三连冠。仅在22天前，她们还在亚锦赛决赛不敌泰国、错失直通奥运资格，主攻吴梦洁决赛轰下26分，全队平均年龄不足23岁、仅龚翔宇和王梦洁两名老将压阵，第三局在2比10落后下逆转封王。这支年轻队伍接下来将以2027年世界杯和世界排名冲击2028年洛杉矶奥运会门票为目标。
summary.zh_hant: 中國女排9月22日在名古屋決賽以3比0（25比19、25比20、25比23）橫掃東道主日本，奪得隊史第十枚亞運金牌、實現三連冠。僅在22天前，她們還在亞錦賽決賽不敵泰國、錯失直通奧運資格，主攻吳夢潔決賽轟下26分，全隊平均年齡不足23歲、僅龔翔宇和王夢潔兩名老將壓陣，第三局在2比10落後下逆轉封王。這支年輕隊伍接下來將以2027年世界盃和世界排名衝擊2028年洛杉磯奧運會門票為目標。

summary.en: Hong Kong China Rugby has confirmed its men's and women's sevens squads for the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya, where rugby sevens runs Oct 1-3. summary.en: Hong Kong sanda fighter Leung Yu-hang took silver in the men's 60kg final on 24 September at the Aichi Prefectural Budokan, losing by WPD (points-disparity victory) to China's Tang Sisuo, the reigning National Games champion. The 21-year-old former world champion revealed afterwards he had hidden a right-foot injury for two weeks before the Games. It is Hong Kong sanda's best Asian Games result ever and the squad's second medal of these Games after Chan Tsz-ching's women's 52kg bronze, earning Leung a HK$500,000 Jockey Club award.
summary.zh_hans: 21岁散打港将梁宇航于9月24日在爱知县武道馆举行的亚运男子60公斤级决赛中，不敌中国应届全运冠军唐思硕（WPD优势胜利），夺得银牌。这位2023年世界锦标赛冠军、首登亚运舞台即摘银，更是散打港队历届亚运最佳成绩，连同陈紫晴前一天的女子52公斤级铜牌，散打港队今届已袋走1银1铜，可获赛马会奖励计划50万元奖金。梁宇航赛后透露，赛前两周右脚受伤至「行都行唔到」，一直保守秘密以免被对手研究。

summary.en: Eight Chinese players qualified for the 2026 Scottish Open main event after the final qualifying day in Leicester on 23 September. Liu Hongyu came from 2-3 down to beat 10-time ranking champion Jimmy White 4-3, while Fan Zhengyi, Lyu Haotian, Zhao Hanyang and Xu Si also won through, joining Yao Pengcheng, Jiang Jun and Gao Yang. Ding Junhui opted out, leaving him the only one of 34 Chinese players to skip the event.
